name: Bvlgari Hotel, Dubai
insider_take: Where Italian artistry meets Arabian luxury on a man-made island shaped like a seahorse
whats_special: This ultra-exclusive resort sits on Jumeirah Bay Island, accessible only by a private bridge, making it Dubai's most secluded luxury retreat. The hotel features Italy's largest overseas Bulgari resort with authentic Italian design by Antonio Citterio, plus a private 1.7km beach and the world's first Bulgari Marina with mega-yacht berths.
pro_tip: Book the signature Bulgari Suite for exclusive access to the private island's helipad - perfect for dramatic arrivals and the ultimate Instagram moment with Dubai's skyline backdrop.
dont_miss: The infinity pool overlooking Dubai skyline, Il Cafe's authentic Italian gelato made fresh daily, and sunset cocktails at the overwater Il Bar - Dubai's only bar extending into the Arabian Gulf on stilts.
pros: Iconic luxury Italian design with Bvlgari's signature elegance
Prime location on Jumeirah Bay Island with stunning marina views
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with signature treatments
Multiple world-class dining venues including Il Ristorante
cons: Island location requires transportation to mainland attractions
